text: I wake up at six every morning, and my day follows a steady rhythm. First, I stretch for ten minutes, then shower and eat a quick breakfast of oatmeal and fruit. By seven-thirty, I’m at my desk, starting work. My schedule is predictable: I handle emails, attend two or three meetings, and focus on projects until lunch. At noon, I take a short walk outside. In the afternoon, I dive back into tasks until five. After work, I hit the gym for an hour—lifting weights or doing cardio. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, or watching a show. I’m in bed by ten. This consistency keeps me productive and calm.
